visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video starts with a split-screen layout. The top half shows a man with short dark hair, wearing glasses and a striped polo shirt, sitting in a well-lit office-like environment with a headset microphone. The bottom half shows a group of five women sitting around a table in a bright indoor room with large windows, looking at the screen and laughing. (2) The scene transitions to the man standing in a hallway with white walls and a glass door. He begins performing rhythmic stretching exercises, touching his toes. The split-screen continues with the women now standing outdoors in a brick-walled courtyard, attempting to follow his movements while laughing and pointing at the camera. (3) A close-up shot shows one of the women in a white T-shirt looking tired and rubbing her neck. The man on the top screen gestures towards her, then holds up a white plastic bottle with a green and yellow label. (4) Close-up shots of the product, a bottle of Centrum 'Good Night' probiotics, are shown on a kitchen counter and in the man's hands. Graphic overlays showing a saffron flower and chemical structures appear around the bottle. (5) The man is shown lying in a bed under a beige blanket, wearing a smartwatch and looking peacefully asleep in a dimly lit room. (6) The man wakes up in bed, stretching his arms upwards with a satisfied expression. The women are shown outdoors again, looking impressed and leaning towards the camera. (7) The video concludes with the split-screen showing the man and the women all waving and cheering enthusiastically at their respective cameras.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a loud, high-energy male greeting in Mandarin, accompanied by the sounds of several women laughing and chatting in the background. A bright, upbeat pop BGM with a strong electronic beat fades in. (2) A sharp transition SFX leads into the male voice counting rhythmically 'Yi, Er, San, Si' (1, 2, 3, 4) in time with the music as he leads the stretching exercises. High-pitched cartoon sound effects punctuate the visual movements. (3) The music stays consistent while the male voice shifts to a helpful, informative tone, introducing the product. A soft 'ding' sound effect highlights the appearance of the bottle. (4) A subtle rustling sound of a pill bottle being handled is heard. The male voice continues with a clear, professional narration about the ingredients of the probiotics over a slightly lowered BGM volume. (5) The audio track becomes slightly calmer with less background chatter during the sleeping sequence, then swells back to high energy with a collective group cheer and loud clapping at the end.
